episodes.title: The Lift Register
episodes.setup: The next lead is the depot lift register. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The lift carried a covered passenger trolley to the river exit, not the roof.
episodes.amara: I remember that trolley from the delivery Victor insisted he arranged himself.
episodes.hook: The lift is empty. Its wheels have left a wet track toward the quay.

episodes.title: Wet Wheels
episodes.setup: The next lead is the trolley wheel marks. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The tracks end at a hired launch; its owner was paid to leave before our arrival.
episodes.amara: Victor always called a hired service a favour people owed him.
episodes.hook: The launch has gone. The hire receipt names a fuel stop upstream.

episodes.title: The Fuel Receipt
episodes.setup: The next lead is the launch fuel receipt. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The receipt includes fuel for a second boat that never appeared on the public schedule.
episodes.amara: He wants us admiring the first trail while he chooses another.
episodes.hook: We reach the stop after the second boat leaves. A blue mooring cord remains.

episodes.title: Blue Cord
episodes.setup: The next lead is the cut mooring cord. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The cord matches a repair batch sold to a riverside workshop.
episodes.amara: That workshop repaired Ethan's pushchair once. I can identify the owner, not the person in that boat.
episodes.hook: The owner confirms a hurried repair, but points to an already deserted landing.

episodes.title: The Quiet Landing
episodes.setup: The next lead is the landing maintenance notice. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Someone reserved the landing under a company Victor used during our relationship.
episodes.amara: He called it his company; other people did the work and signed the bills.
episodes.hook: A caretaker has just watched a van leave. The reservation has a forwarding number.

episodes.title: Forwarded Calls
episodes.setup: The next lead is the landing forwarding number. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The number forwards to a switchboard rather than Victor's handset.
episodes.amara: A voice on a phone is not proof that Ethan is in the building.
episodes.hook: The switchboard room is empty. Its call sheet records a laundry collection.

episodes.title: Folded Linen
episodes.setup: The next lead is the laundry collection tag. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The collection carried bedding to a guesthouse with a private rear stair.
episodes.amara: I packed that patterned cover for Ethan. Keep the original tag; a photograph alone could be planted.
episodes.hook: The room is warm but vacant. The cover is gone and a stair camera has a gap.

episodes.title: Nine Missing Minutes
episodes.setup: The next lead is the stair camera gap. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A local recorder preserves the minutes missing from the shared camera feed.
episodes.amara: David, decoding a copy does not mean you have seen the whole truth.
episodes.hook: The recording shows a covered carrier entering a taxi. We miss it at the next stop.

episodes.title: The Taxi Queue
episodes.setup: The next lead is the taxi dispatch slip. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The taxi was exchanged for a car paid through an estate-services account.
episodes.amara: That account was created to maintain our home after Ethan's father died.
episodes.hook: The driver has gone off shift. The payment points to a familiar office.

episodes.title: An Empty Office
episodes.setup: The next lead is the estate office visitor book. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor used an old visitor pass to collect a sealed packet before fleeing through the back.
episodes.amara: My child's father provided for us. Victor does not get to rewrite that as his gift.
episodes.hook: We reach the office minutes too late. The packet's receipt leads into the accounts he wants to control.

episodes.title: The Original Signature
episodes.setup: The next lead is the provision agreement signature. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: An original agreement confirms the provision came from Ethan's father, not Victor.
episodes.amara: I chose what to do with my life. Receiving support never made me Victor's property.
episodes.hook: Victor has left the records room. A fresh access request bears his old alias.

episodes.title: The Old Alias
episodes.setup: The next lead is the account access request. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The alias requested a change of contact details immediately before the abduction.
episodes.amara: He used to call every boundary I set an insult.
episodes.hook: The request has been refused, but its delivery runner has already left for a notary.

episodes.title: The Notary's Copy
episodes.setup: The next lead is the notarised contact form. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The notary retained a copy showing a substituted telephone number.
episodes.amara: That is not my number. I can challenge the substitution myself.
episodes.hook: The caller has vanished. The substituted number shares a billing address with a storage unit.

episodes.title: Paid Storage
episodes.setup: The next lead is the storage billing address. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The unit held household papers, but fresh tyre marks show the boxes were moved.
episodes.amara: He wants the papers to look like ownership of me and my son.
episodes.hook: The unit is empty. One torn inventory label names the next courier.

episodes.title: The Torn Label
episodes.setup: The next lead is the courier inventory label. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A courier scanned the boxes onto a vehicle heading for a private reception hall.
episodes.amara: Victor used that hall to tell people he made my success possible.
episodes.hook: The vehicle has unloaded and gone. The hall's cloakroom holds its numbered token.

episodes.title: Numbered Coats
episodes.setup: The next lead is the cloakroom token. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The token links the visitor to an envelope collected by a hall employee.
episodes.amara: Please protect that employee. Victor uses people's need for work against them.
episodes.hook: We arrive after the envelope changes hands. A wage note names the payment desk.

episodes.title: The Wage Note
episodes.setup: The next lead is the employee payment note. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The note proves the employee was hired for a delivery, not told about Ethan.
episodes.amara: We need witnesses who feel safe enough to tell the truth.
episodes.hook: The employee is safe, but the recipient has left. The envelope carried a copy-shop stamp.

episodes.title: Carbon Copies
episodes.setup: The next lead is the copy-shop stamp. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor copied a financial statement and removed the page identifying the source of the funds.
episodes.amara: Keep the missing page with the rest. He cannot have the credit by cutting out a name.
episodes.hook: The copier log survives; Victor does not. His next print job was a hotel booking.

episodes.title: The Unused Booking
episodes.setup: The next lead is the prepaid hotel booking. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The booking was bait; a porter remembers a car waiting at the service door.
episodes.amara: A room in our names does not mean either of us agreed to stay there.
episodes.hook: We miss the service car. Its payment came from the account Victor tried to seize.

episodes.title: Control Refused
episodes.setup: The next lead is the rejected account mandate. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The mandate is blocked, preserving Amara's control of the provision, but Victor has moved again.
episodes.amara: The money is not his. I will not sign away Ethan's future to validate his story.
episodes.hook: A message arrives from a page David once built. Victor has found another way to boast.

episodes.title: David's Old Page
episodes.setup: The next lead is the cloned portfolio page. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The threatening page is a clone of David's work, hosted somewhere else.
episodes.amara: You did not send it. Now show me how we distinguish its source from your name on it.
episodes.hook: The host is empty of live connections. Its invoice refers to a shared workstation.

episodes.title: The Shared Workstation
episodes.setup: The next lead is the workstation session record. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A session token was reused after its owner logged out.
episodes.amara: People can be used without knowing it. Do not accuse the owner just to move faster.
episodes.hook: We reach the workstation after the visitor leaves. A printer spool retains a route slip.

episodes.title: The Route Slip
episodes.setup: The next lead is the printer spool entry. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The slip gives a meeting place, but its creation time predates Victor's message.
episodes.amara: He is making yesterday look like now. We cannot let urgency choose for us.
episodes.hook: The meeting place is deserted. A newer correction sits in the print queue.

episodes.title: The Correction
episodes.setup: The next lead is the revised route file. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The correction was uploaded through a compromised maintenance account.
episodes.amara: Whoever maintains the building may know which door that account opens.
episodes.hook: The maintainer has changed the password. The old login points to an industrial block.

episodes.title: The Wrong Door
episodes.setup: The next lead is the maintenance door log. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: David's first decoding follows a decoy door; the genuine log lists a different entrance.
episodes.amara: Being wrong is not the end, David. Pretending you cannot be wrong would help Victor.
episodes.hook: The genuine entrance is open, but the passenger lift has already descended.

episodes.title: Below the Signal
episodes.setup: The next lead is the basement repeater label. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A repeater made Victor's phone appear upstairs while he used a basement exit.
episodes.amara: You can decode a signal without knowing where my son is. Keep checking both.
episodes.hook: The basement exit is vacant. Its repeater was rented under a delivery contract.

episodes.title: The Rental Contract
episodes.setup: The next lead is the repeater rental contract. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The rental company recorded a return to a parcel locker.
episodes.amara: Victor expects us to chase his equipment while he travels light.
episodes.hook: The locker is empty. Its access receipt identifies a second compartment.

episodes.title: The Second Compartment
episodes.setup: The next lead is the locker access receipt. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The second compartment contains a memory card with a recent recording, but no reliable location.
episodes.amara: I recognise Ethan's little blanket. I will not mistake that for knowing he is safe.
episodes.hook: We have a trace of him, not him. The card's packaging names a recording studio.

episodes.title: Recorded Applause
episodes.setup: The next lead is the studio booking sheet. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor recorded a speech claiming he alone could protect Amara.
episodes.amara: He wants an audience for a role nobody gave him.
episodes.hook: The studio has just closed. A hired car appears on its exit camera.

episodes.title: An Unbroken Original
episodes.setup: The next lead is the original studio recording. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The unedited recording exposes Victor's false account and includes an audible station announcement.
episodes.amara: Keep the whole recording. My history is not his speech to edit.
episodes.hook: The car leaves the station before we arrive. The announcement points toward an old part of my life.

episodes.title: The Old Station
episodes.setup: The next lead is the station parcel register. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A parcel was collected using a nickname Victor used during the relationship.
episodes.amara: I know that nickname. Knowing him once does not make me responsible for what he does now.
episodes.hook: The collector has left. A forwarding card names a former neighbour.

episodes.title: A Neighbour's Door
episodes.setup: The next lead is the neighbour's forwarding card. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The neighbour refused to hide Victor and kept the address he tried to use.
episodes.amara: She helped me when we separated. Victor told everyone it was his kindness.
episodes.hook: The neighbour is safe. Victor left before we came, dropping a reunion invitation.

episodes.title: The Reunion Invitation
episodes.setup: The next lead is the reunion invitation. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor arranged a reunion under Amara's name without her permission.
episodes.amara: I never agreed to see him. The invitation is another claim over my choices.
episodes.hook: The hired room is empty. A caterer has a new delivery address.

episodes.title: An Unset Table
episodes.setup: The next lead is the catering delivery note. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The food was diverted to a caretaker's flat that Victor borrowed.
episodes.amara: He likes a borrowed room to look like a home he built.
episodes.hook: The flat has just been cleared. A caretaker kept a duplicate key receipt.

episodes.title: The Duplicate Key
episodes.setup: The next lead is the duplicate key receipt. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The key opened a side gate at the place Amara once shared with Victor.
episodes.amara: Leaving that relationship was my decision. He cannot turn a key into consent.
episodes.hook: The gate swings open on an empty yard. A removed notice leaves a fresh outline.

episodes.title: The Missing Notice
episodes.setup: The next lead is the yard notice photograph. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A neighbour photographed the notice before Victor tore it down: a vehicle collection slot.
episodes.amara: Someone noticed what he thought nobody would remember.
episodes.hook: We miss the collection by minutes. The vehicle depot records the receiving signature.

episodes.title: Someone Else's Name
episodes.setup: The next lead is the depot receiving signature. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor signed with the name of a former colleague whose work he used to claim.
episodes.amara: Ask the colleague what they made, not what Victor said he made.
episodes.hook: The colleague identifies the forgery. Victor's hired van has already left the depot.

episodes.title: Credit Taken
episodes.setup: The next lead is the colleague's original project file. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The file disproves one of Victor's favourite success stories and contains his old delivery contact.
episodes.amara: He did that to me too: made my effort sound like proof of his greatness.
episodes.hook: The contact has missed him. A fresh voice message mentions a shuttered shop.

episodes.title: Behind the Shutters
episodes.setup: The next lead is the shop utility reading. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The shop was occupied recently, although Victor told the owner it stood empty.
episodes.amara: I can recognise the bag in the owner's photograph. I cannot tell who carried it.
episodes.hook: The shutters rise on nobody. A utility top-up points to another property agent.

episodes.title: The Story She Keeps
episodes.setup: The next lead is the property agent message. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The agent retained Victor's instruction to describe Amara as returning voluntarily.
episodes.amara: I did not return. I am looking for my child, and I will say it in my own words.
episodes.hook: The agent stops helping him, but he slips away. His next demand concerns Ethan's father's provision.

episodes.title: The Provision File
episodes.setup: The next lead is the original provision file. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The file records that Ethan's father provided for Amara and Ethan after her separation from Victor.
episodes.amara: His father is dead. His name and the circumstances are not for Victor to invent for leverage.
episodes.hook: Victor has left the archive, taking a duplicate index card rather than the original file.

episodes.title: The Duplicate Index
episodes.setup: The next lead is the duplicate archive index. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The index points to a family-services office, not to cash Victor can claim.
episodes.amara: Money set aside for Ethan is not a reward for the man who threatens him.
episodes.hook: The office closes just before we arrive. A late visitor left a collection authorisation.

episodes.title: Permission Denied
episodes.setup: The next lead is the collection authorisation. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The authorisation used a copied signature; Amara can revoke it directly.
episodes.amara: That signature is mine from another document. This permission was never mine.
episodes.hook: The forgery is stopped, but its messenger has already gone to a private mailbox.

episodes.title: The Private Mailbox
episodes.setup: The next lead is the mailbox rental form. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The rental was paid by an intermediary who thought they were handling household correspondence.
episodes.amara: Tell them what happened. Let them choose whether to help us rather than order them about.
episodes.hook: The intermediary cooperates. The box is empty except for a dispatch wrapper.

episodes.title: Wrapped in Paper
episodes.setup: The next lead is the dispatch wrapper. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The wrapper carried a keepsake inventory photographed before removal.
episodes.amara: I remember choosing those things for Ethan. Victor was not there.
episodes.hook: The carrier has moved them on. A photograph reveals a reflection of a ferry sign.

episodes.title: The Reflected Sign
episodes.setup: The next lead is the reflected ferry sign. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The sign identifies a waiting shelter, but the photographed sailing has already departed.
episodes.amara: I want to run toward it too. Check the date before we lose another hour.
episodes.hook: We miss that crossing. Its passenger clerk remembers a private road transfer instead.

episodes.title: No Public Ticket
episodes.setup: The next lead is the road transfer docket. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The transfer bypassed the public passenger list using a contractor's vehicle.
episodes.amara: Not appearing on a list does not mean my child was never there.
episodes.hook: The contractor's yard is empty. A dashboard service tag gives the next workshop.

episodes.title: The Dashboard Tag
episodes.setup: The next lead is the vehicle service tag. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The workshop replaced a damaged mirror after a hurried departure.
episodes.amara: Keep the broken mirror. Something discarded can still tell us where he went.
episodes.hook: We arrive after pickup. A witness saw the vehicle turn toward an estate storehouse.

episodes.title: The Storehouse Lock
episodes.setup: The next lead is the storehouse access list. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The lock was opened using an expired estate pass that should have been cancelled.
episodes.amara: I will cancel every old permission I can. Victor does not inherit access to us.
episodes.hook: The pass is revoked. The room is empty, with an event badge left on a shelf.

episodes.title: What Cannot Be Signed Away
episodes.setup: The next lead is the revoked access record. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The estate confirms Amara's authority and closes Victor's old access routes.
episodes.amara: I have protected part of Ethan's future. I still need him here to live it.
episodes.hook: Victor escapes another doorway. The badge belongs to an event where he plans to call himself our saviour.

episodes.title: The Saviour's Badge
episodes.setup: The next lead is the event staff badge. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The badge grants service access to a hall where Victor booked a private speech.
episodes.amara: He wants people watching him help, even while he is the reason we need help.
episodes.hook: The dressing room is empty. A cue sheet shows an unscheduled video call.

episodes.title: The Cue Sheet
episodes.setup: The next lead is the altered stage cue sheet. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The call was pre-recorded and played as if live.
episodes.amara: A recording of Ethan is not Ethan within reach. I will keep asking when it was made.
episodes.hook: The playback room has been cleared. Its operator saved the delivery filename.

episodes.title: Before the Applause
episodes.setup: The next lead is the delivered video filename. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The filename links the recording to a hired edit suite across town.
episodes.amara: Do not let him cut my voice out of my own story again.
episodes.hook: The editor has just handed back the drive. A taxi receipt remains on the desk.

episodes.title: The Editor's Receipt
episodes.setup: The next lead is the edit-suite taxi receipt. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The taxi carried the drive to a promotional office, not to Victor's location.
episodes.amara: He sends his image one way and takes my child another.
episodes.hook: The office is deserted. A staff rota identifies who accepted the drive.

episodes.title: The Unwilling Witness
episodes.setup: The next lead is the office staff rota. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A worker explains the collection route and asks to keep their home address private.
episodes.amara: We can protect a witness without making them disappear from the truth.
episodes.hook: The worker is safe. The collector has left for a pop-up interview room.

episodes.title: The Empty Interview
episodes.setup: The next lead is the interview room reservation. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The interview was cancelled after Victor learned someone kept an unedited copy.
episodes.amara: He can lose an audience. Ethan cannot lose another chance because we chase applause.
episodes.hook: We arrive after the cancellation. The room hire was refunded to a travel agency.

episodes.title: The Refund Trail
episodes.setup: The next lead is the room hire refund. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The agency redirected the refund into a private minibus booking.
episodes.amara: That was provision for a journey, not proof that everyone on it knew what he was doing.
episodes.hook: The bus has departed. The dispatcher retains an amended stop list.

episodes.title: The Removed Stop
episodes.setup: The next lead is the amended minibus stop list. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A public stop was replaced with a loading bay behind the hall.
episodes.amara: Victor thinks a hidden entrance makes him cleverer than the people he uses.
episodes.hook: The loading bay is empty. A steward remembers a missing equipment crate.

episodes.title: The Equipment Crate
episodes.setup: The next lead is the crate delivery record. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The crate was cover for moving belongings into a courier van.
episodes.amara: Keep checking for Ethan himself. His things matter because they can lead us to him.
episodes.hook: The van slips out before we arrive. Its dispatch record names a night market.

episodes.title: No Standing Ovation
episodes.setup: The next lead is the unedited event feed. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The preserved feed contradicts Victor's public story; his planned applause dies away.
episodes.amara: Let people hear what I actually said. I am not his grateful ending.
episodes.hook: Victor abandons the hall before capture. At the night market someone has seen the courier's crate.

episodes.title: After Closing
episodes.setup: The next lead is the market courier token. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A night porter saw the crate handed to a different driver.
episodes.amara: Ask what the porter saw, not whether the porter agrees with our theory.
episodes.hook: The new driver is gone. A numbered token identifies a food stall collection point.

episodes.title: The Last Stall
episodes.setup: The next lead is the stall collection token. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The stall owner kept a payment envelope with a warehouse mark.
episodes.amara: Victor once took credit for helping this owner. They remember who really paid.
episodes.hook: The envelope's collector has just left. The mark leads to a cold-storage lane.

episodes.title: The Cold Lane
episodes.setup: The next lead is the warehouse shift board. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The night shift let a van through under a food delivery booking.
episodes.amara: A routine can hide someone for a moment. It cannot erase every person who saw it.
episodes.hook: The van leaves through a second gate. A broken seal gives us its freight number.

episodes.title: A Broken Seal
episodes.setup: The next lead is the discarded freight seal. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The seal matches a container opened at a roadside repair shelter.
episodes.amara: I recognise Ethan's cover in the shelter photograph. Please verify who took it and when.
episodes.hook: The shelter is empty. A mechanic recorded a replaced battery serial number.

episodes.title: The Battery Number
episodes.setup: The next lead is the replacement battery receipt. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The receipt identifies a hired vehicle returned to a late-night depot.
episodes.amara: Returning the vehicle is another way to shed a name, not to become innocent.
episodes.hook: We miss the return driver. The depot camera shows a ride-share collection.

episodes.title: The Collected Passenger
episodes.setup: The next lead is the ride-share pickup record. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: A passenger transferred to a small guest court rather than the booked destination.
episodes.amara: Follow what happened, David. Your first prediction does not have to be the answer.
episodes.hook: The court room is empty. Fresh bedding tags point to a mobile laundry.

episodes.title: The Moving Laundry
episodes.setup: The next lead is the mobile laundry route. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The laundry driver delivered to a safehouse without knowing who occupied it.
episodes.amara: Tell the driver the truth. Another frightened person is not another Victor.
episodes.hook: The driver guides us there, but the house has just been cleared. A cupboard holds a keycard sleeve.

episodes.title: The Sleeve
episodes.setup: The next lead is the discarded keycard sleeve. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The sleeve belongs to a clinic annex rented for private accommodation.
episodes.amara: A place that looks respectable can still have a door nobody checked.
episodes.hook: The annex has no occupants left. A staff member remembers a courier collecting documents.

episodes.title: The Document Bag
episodes.setup: The next lead is the courier bag scan. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The scan identifies a documents service used to create new travel permissions.
episodes.amara: He cannot make permission real by printing my name on it.
episodes.hook: The bag has moved on. The service keeps a copy of the requestor's identity document.

episodes.title: Dawn Without Him
episodes.setup: The next lead is the identity service request. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The request exposes a false identity, closing one route out of the district.
episodes.amara: The people who helped us are safe. We have stopped one route, not found my son.
episodes.hook: Dawn reaches an empty departure room. Victor has another name waiting in the records.

episodes.title: A Borrowed Identity
episodes.setup: The next lead is the false identity copy. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The copy combines details from two people who never authorised its use.
episodes.amara: Those people deserve their names back too.
episodes.hook: The document office is empty. A courier receipt points to a registrar's assistant.

episodes.title: The Assistant's Ledger
episodes.setup: The next lead is the assistant payment ledger. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The assistant logged a suspicious delivery and refused to certify it.
episodes.amara: Refusing him mattered. Let the assistant know the record helps us.
episodes.hook: The delivery runner has fled. A watermark identifies the paper supplier.

episodes.title: Watermarked Lies
episodes.setup: The next lead is the paper supplier invoice. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor bought official-looking stationery from a legitimate supplier using a false purpose.
episodes.amara: The paper is real. The consent he prints on it is not.
episodes.hook: The order has been collected. Its pickup code also opened a hired cabinet.

episodes.title: The Hired Cabinet
episodes.setup: The next lead is the cabinet access code. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The cabinet held forged letters for a property manager.
episodes.amara: I will speak to the manager myself. Nobody needs to interpret my permission for me.
episodes.hook: The manager refuses the letters, but Victor has already used a different entrance.

episodes.title: The Service Entrance
episodes.setup: The next lead is the property service log. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The service log records access under an emergency maintenance pretext.
episodes.amara: He turns other people's helpfulness into a story about his own importance.
episodes.hook: The maintenance room is vacant. A tool case carries a vehicle hire sticker.

episodes.title: The Sticker
episodes.setup: The next lead is the vehicle hire sticker. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The hire company finds a changed return address on the contract.
episodes.amara: Keep both versions. He relies on the changed page becoming the only page.
episodes.hook: The vehicle is gone from the new address. Its original return yard has a witness.

episodes.title: The First Address
episodes.setup: The next lead is the original hire contract. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The witness saw a handover between vehicles and recorded the second registration.
episodes.amara: Someone stopping to remember one detail can keep this search alive.
episodes.hook: We reach the second vehicle after it is abandoned. Its glovebox contains a gate receipt.

episodes.title: The Gate Receipt
episodes.setup: The next lead is the private gate receipt. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The receipt names an overnight lodging block booked with forged authority.
episodes.amara: That is my signature copied again. I will challenge it wherever he uses it.
episodes.hook: The booking is cancelled. The room has just emptied through a connecting passage.

episodes.title: Connecting Rooms
episodes.setup: The next lead is the lodging floor plan. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The connecting passage leads to a courtyard invisible from the reception desk.
episodes.amara: David, a map is useful only if we notice the door somebody actually used.
episodes.hook: The courtyard gate closes after the getaway car. A passenger dropped a printed speech.

episodes.title: The Name He Wants
episodes.setup: The next lead is the discarded victory speech. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor's speech demands praise and control; it contains the address of his next intended audience.
episodes.amara: He can keep saying he made me. The records and my voice say otherwise.
episodes.hook: We reach another empty platform. His next audience may be the people still financing his escapes.

episodes.title: The Patron List
episodes.setup: The next lead is the speech sponsor list. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Several sponsors paid for transport believing Victor was organising a family reunion.
episodes.amara: Tell them there is no reunion I agreed to. Let them see the original messages.
episodes.hook: The organiser has left the meeting room. A sponsor retains the transport invoice.

episodes.title: An Unpaid Invoice
episodes.setup: The next lead is the transport invoice. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The driver refuses further work after learning what the journey concealed.
episodes.amara: We do not need another person trapped by what they were told.
episodes.hook: The last paid journey is over. Its fuel card records a roadside stop.

episodes.title: The Fuel Card
episodes.setup: The next lead is the roadside fuel transaction. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The transaction belongs to a car travelling toward a private social club.
episodes.amara: Victor used to tell that club every good thing in my life was his doing.
episodes.hook: The car leaves before we arrive. A member kept the visitor invitation.

episodes.title: The Visitor Invitation
episodes.setup: The next lead is the club visitor invitation. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The invitation promises a reconciliation Amara never accepted.
episodes.amara: I will say no in my own voice. It is not an opening for negotiation.
episodes.hook: The club cancels access. Victor has already collected a package from its cloakroom.

episodes.title: The Cloakroom Parcel
episodes.setup: The next lead is the parcel collection signature. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The parcel contains printed demands, sent onward to a message courier.
episodes.amara: My money or Ethan is his threat, not a debt I owe.
episodes.hook: The courier has delivered the demands. The return envelope points to a small business centre.

episodes.title: The Message Desk
episodes.setup: The next lead is the business centre dispatch log. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The centre recorded the sender's visit and a subsequent call for a car.
episodes.amara: Keep the threat intact. Do not let his wording become our account of what is true.
episodes.hook: The desk is deserted. A concierge remembers the car's unusual roof rack.

episodes.title: The Roof Rack
episodes.setup: The next lead is the concierge vehicle photograph. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The photograph identifies a rented estate car carrying a folded cot.
episodes.amara: I recognise the cot. We are closer to something he touched, not entitled to assume the rest.
episodes.hook: We reach the rental yard after the cot has been moved into a delivery truck.

episodes.title: The Transfer Truck
episodes.setup: The next lead is the delivery truck route sheet. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The route was shortened to include an unscheduled service tunnel.
episodes.amara: He keeps changing plans because people stop accepting his version.
episodes.hook: The truck exits before we reach the tunnel. Its access pass records the next compound.

episodes.title: The Last Sponsor
episodes.setup: The next lead is the compound access sponsorship. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The remaining sponsor revokes Victor's pass after Amara shows the unedited evidence.
episodes.amara: They can withdraw their help. They cannot hand me back the hours Ethan has lost.
episodes.hook: The compound is emptied before the revocation reaches the gate. A caretaker finds a service-route diagram.

episodes.title: Credit Withdrawn
episodes.setup: The next lead is the sponsors' original correspondence. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The correspondence preserves how Victor misled his helpers and cuts off this funding network.
episodes.amara: He is losing the audience he demanded. I am still a mother waiting for my child.
episodes.hook: The caretaker opens a door onto an empty room. The diagram points to a smaller, older network of exits.

episodes.title: The Service Diagram
episodes.setup: The next lead is the compound service diagram. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The diagram links the compound to a shuttered pumping station.
episodes.amara: We follow the exit people can use, not the grand entrance Victor wants us watching.
episodes.hook: The station is empty. Recent footprints lead to a maintenance lift.

episodes.title: The Maintenance Lift
episodes.setup: The next lead is the lift inspection strip. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The strip records an unscheduled descent shortly before our arrival.
episodes.amara: A few minutes are still enough for him to move. Check where the lift actually stops.
episodes.hook: The lift returns without passengers. Its lower gate has a fresh delivery chalk mark.

episodes.title: The Chalk Mark
episodes.setup: The next lead is the lower gate chalk mark. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The mark belongs to a supplies route that crosses the river under a bridge.
episodes.amara: I know the blanket in that witness's description. Ask when they last saw it.
episodes.hook: The bridge shelter has just been cleared. A portable radio still carries a local channel setting.

episodes.title: The Local Channel
episodes.setup: The next lead is the portable radio setting. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The channel relays a message from a yard farther downriver.
episodes.amara: A voice can be relayed. We must follow the person, not only the sound.
episodes.hook: The yard is empty by the time we arrive. A new recording includes Ethan calling for Mum.

episodes.title: The Voice She Knows
episodes.setup: The next lead is the original yard recording. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Amara recognises Ethan's voice; an independent time marker places the recording recently.
episodes.amara: That is my son. Keep me with the evidence, David; do not turn hope into a certainty we have not earned.
episodes.hook: The recording gives us a direction, not a rescue. A gate bell in the background identifies another landing.

episodes.title: The Gate Bell
episodes.setup: The next lead is the landing bell recording. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The bell matches a sheltered landing used by a private river shuttle.
episodes.amara: Tell me what you can verify. I need hope that can survive the next door opening.
episodes.hook: The shuttle leaves just before we reach it. Its return schedule names a service pier.

episodes.title: The Return Schedule
episodes.setup: The next lead is the shuttle return schedule. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The service pier has a road exit absent from the passenger map.
episodes.amara: He counts on us arriving where the ticket says, instead of where he goes.
episodes.hook: The pier is vacant. A road barrier keeps a photograph of the departing vehicle.

episodes.title: Beyond the Barrier
episodes.setup: The next lead is the barrier camera original. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The photograph shows a vehicle heading toward an old distribution court.
episodes.amara: Keep the original. Even now he will try to say the whole search was his design.
episodes.hook: The court gate opens on a recently vacated room. A phone begins ringing on the table.

episodes.title: The Ringing Phone
episodes.setup: The next lead is the abandoned phone call record. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: Victor calls the abandoned handset to boast while a background signal identifies a transfer point.
episodes.amara: You have not won, Victor. I am still here, and Ethan is still my son.
episodes.hook: The transfer point is empty when we arrive. One overlooked dispatch label survives the cleared floor.

episodes.title: Another Door Opens
episodes.setup: The next lead is the overlooked dispatch label. We need its original source before Victor moves again.
episodes.reveal: The label links the getaway to a previously unknown relay address; the trail has not ended.
episodes.amara: We missed him here. We keep the evidence, protect the people who helped, and go after the next lead.
episodes.hook: There is no rescue behind this door. A fresh address waits in the case file, and Ethan is still out there.
